title: a park the broker refuses requeues the delivery, and it is parked once the broker takes it
comment: Before Python 0.7.14 and Ruby 0.7.16, both nacked the delivery without requeue when the park publish failed: the message was dropped, or dead-lettered by the broker if the source queue had a dead-letter exchange. Java rejects with requeue, Go nacks with requeue, .NET releases it.

The broker refuses the park through a reject-publish policy on {queue}.parked. A quorum parked queue admits one message into an empty queue at a limit of zero, so on a library whose parked queue is quorum the case is weaker (see ROADMAP, Quorum rungs).

steps.comment: the park is attempted and refused, more than once
